mainText:
Assistance On · Simulated presentation, not a model call
A month in numbers

Estimate a smaller referral loop. Count gathering, judgement and double-checks; keep pharmacy labour separate from operator hours.

The public referral count defines this manual loop, not all NHSBSA staff work. Edited figures are assumptions.
